fields.label: Approval Path
fields.help: Select the approval or support package your company is preparing. Program Type defines the product boundary; Approval Path defines the approval sought.

optionLabels.SUPPLIER_TC: Supplier support to an aircraft TC applicant
optionLabels.SUPPLIER_STC: Supplier support to an aircraft STC applicant
optionLabels.TSOA_TC: TSO authorization plus TC installation support
optionLabels.TSOA_STC: TSO authorization plus STC installation support
optionLabels.LODA: FAA letter of TSO design approval (foreign applicant)

fields.label: Separate Certification Data Plan
fields.help: Select Yes only when your company or the aircraft applicant requires a separate controlled plan for certification-data ownership, delivery, configuration and submission status. Select No when this information is managed in the Certification Plan, PSCP, compliance matrix or document register.

fields.label: Aircraft Applicant / Integrator
fields.help: Company responsible for the aircraft TC/STC or installation approval. Used to plan the interface and delivery responsibilities.

fields.label: Aircraft Certification Basis / Allocation Reference
fields.help: Record the aircraft certification basis and the document allocating requirements to your product. This intake record does not establish approval.

fields.label: Product Function And Boundary
fields.help: Describe what the product does, what is included and which installation responsibilities are outside your scope.

fields.label: Software In Scope
fields.help: Whether airborne software lifecycle data are part of this program. Add every applicable software item in the next step.

fields.label: Hardware In Scope
fields.help: Whether airborne electronic hardware lifecycle data are part of this program. Add every applicable hardware item in the next step.

fields.label: External Suppliers In Scope
fields.help: Whether outside organizations supply development work, hardware, software or lifecycle evidence for this program.

fields.label: Supplier Work Share Definition
fields.help: Describe whether percentages measure engineering hours, contract value or another quantity. Use the same stated basis when comparing suppliers.

fields.label: Supplier Oversight And Authority Coordination
fields.help: Record proposed reviews, data access, foreign-site coordination and questions for the certification lead. ISAF does not calculate FAA level of involvement.

fields.label: Authority Project Reference
fields.help: Project identifier assigned by the authority, when available. Retained with the intake planning record.

fields.label: Production And Quality Arrangements
fields.help: Identify manufacturing sites, quality-system ownership and the applicable quality manual or planned evidence.

fields.label: Application And Approval Records Plan
fields.help: Identify the application, conformance and delegated approval records agreed with the certification lead. Issued FAA/designee records must be obtained and imported through the program register.

fields.label: Intake Owner
fields.help: Person coordinating completion of the intake and unresolved inputs. This is not an app login or approval signature.

fields.label: Intake Notes
fields.help: Record assumptions, unresolved scope questions and references used in answering the survey.

fields.label: CAGE Code
fields.help: Five-character Commercial and Government Entity code for the legal company, when assigned. A non-U.S. organization may use an NCAGE. Used in the company identity block on generated document covers; it is never part of a document PN.

fields.label: Company Address
fields.help: Legal or controlled program address to print with the company identity on generated document covers. Enter the address approved for certification correspondence and document issue.

suppliers.label: Supplier Home Country
suppliers.help: Country where the supplier organization is based. Work locations may differ; record them separately.

suppliers.label: Countries Where Work Is Performed
suppliers.help: List the actual development, verification, manufacturing and lower-tier work locations relevant to this supplier.

suppliers.label: Work Outside The US (%)
suppliers.help: Estimate the percentage of this supplier’s scoped work performed outside the United States, from 0 to 100. State the measurement basis and source; this is not an FAA involvement score.

suppliers.label: Percentage Basis And Source
suppliers.help: Explain whether the work share is based on engineering hours, value or another quantity, and record the source/date of the estimate.

suppliers.label: Supplier Oversight Notes
suppliers.help: Record site access, evidence access, lower-tier suppliers and coordination needs for review by the certification lead.
